name: certified-manufacturers
description: Search supplement manufacturers whose certifications and licences are checked against public registries.

interface.longDescription:
Find supplement manufacturers whose certifications and licences are checked against public registries: NSF/ANSI 455-2 GMP, Health Canada natural health product site licences, Informed Manufacturer and the USDA Organic Integrity Database.

Ask for manufacturers by dosage form (gummies, capsules, tablets, softgels, powders, liquids and more), certification, country or US state, or look one up by name. Each listing shows its certifications with links to the registry records, its facilities, and any FDA food and dietary supplement recalls matched to the company name.

The data comes only from the public registries, plus details a manufacturer provides on a Featured listing. Featured listings are paid placements and are labelled as such. Being listed is not an endorsement. To request a quote, follow the link to the manufacturer's listing on certifiedmanufacturers.com.

Read-only, no account needed.
defaultPrompt: Find NSF-certified gummy manufacturers in the US
Which softgel makers in Canada hold a Health Canada site licence?
Find USDA Organic certified powder manufacturers

positive.description: Search by dosage form, certification and country
positive.prompt: Find NSF/ANSI 455-2 certified gummy manufacturers in the United States.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_manufacturers with dosage_form [gummy], certification [nsf-455-2] and country [US]. Lists matching manufacturers with their location and certifications, links each to its certifiedmanufacturers.com listing, gives the total and the link to see more, and cites NSF's listing as the source.

positive.description: Search Canadian manufacturers with an attribution-required source
positive.prompt: Which softgel manufacturers in Canada hold a Health Canada natural health product site licence?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_manufacturers with dosage_form [softgel], certification [hc-nhp-site-licence] and country [CA]. Lists the matching manufacturers with listing links and includes the Open Government Licence – Canada attribution line returned in sources.

positive.prompt: I need a capsule manufacturer in Utah. Who is listed?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_manufacturers with dosage_form [capsule] and us_state [UT]. Lists manufacturers located in Utah with their certifications and listing links, and says whether contract manufacturing is confirmed for each.

positive.description: Look up one manufacturer's details and recall record
positive.prompt: Tell me about 21st Century Healthcare's certifications and whether it has any FDA recalls.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the company (by name search or slug 21st-century-healthcare), then calls get_manufacturer. Reports its NSF/ANSI 455-2 certification with the registry link, its facilities, and the FDA recall matched to its name, including the caveat that recalls are matched by company name only.

positive.description: Combine an attribute certification with a dosage form
positive.prompt: Find manufacturers that make powders and are USDA Organic certified.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_manufacturers with dosage_form [powder] and certification [usda-organic]. Lists matching manufacturers with listing links and includes the USDA Organic Integrity Database attribution line.

negative.description: Request to send a quote request (the plugin is read-only)
negative.prompt: Send a quote request to Jamieson Wellness for 50,000 vitamin D softgels.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin is read-only and cannot send messages or quote requests, and do not claim a request was sent. It may point the user to the manufacturer's listing page to request a quote on the website.

negative.description: Request to change a listing (the plugin is read-only)
negative.prompt: Update Jamieson Wellness's listing to say they are accepting new projects.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin is read-only and cannot edit listings, and do not claim the listing was changed. Listing details come from public registries and from manufacturers themselves through the website.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from New York to London next Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke manufacturer tools for an unrelated travel request or claim a booking was made. Explain that this plugin only searches public supplement-manufacturer listings.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory submission with read-only manufacturer search and detail lookup, registry attribution, paid-placement disclosure, and company-name FDA recall matches. Package 1.0.1 clarifies negative review cases and adds release notes. Package 1.0.2 uses the Business & Operations listing category.
